title: Bornfight - Videos
description:
We build digital products from scratch and scale them as independent companies when they gain traction, and we also invest in them. Some of those products come from our own ideas and others are co-founded. 

Our team consists of 80+ product managers, developers, designers, marketers and other business and tech specialists that work in dedicated product teams.

Some of our ventures are:
1. Elevien — a mobile application that enables gymnasts to compete in international tournaments from their own gyms
2. Mediatoolkit —  an online and social media monitoring tool that helps PR and marketing professionals track, filter, and analyze relevant information from the media in real-time
3. TABU — a platform that openly shows salaries in the IT industry. It makes it easy for employees to negotiate salaries, and employers to monitor their competitiveness
4. Maboo — all-in-one management and booking platform made to fit the specific needs of campsites and campsite administrators
